m. [दुह्-तृच्] 
__1 A cowherd, a milk-man; मेरौ स्थिते दोग्धरि दोहदक्षे [[

.]] 
__2 A calf. 
__3 A panegyrist, one who writes verses for hire or reward. 
__4 One who performs anything out of interested motives (with a view to profit himself).

__1 A cow which yields milk. 
__2 A wet-nurse (having much milk; Mar. दाइ.) 
__3 A female who gives anything (with acc.).
